neighbours.label: a transitive verb whose object is an already-mentioned thing about to be referred back to ('until the soldiers began using [it]', 'would use [it]'), as against the same verbs taking a new noun object with no antecedent
fire: The old map was lost for decades until a student found it in the archive.
Grandma kept the knife sharp because she would use it every day.
The song was so catchy that the band decided to record it again.
The bridge was unsafe, so engineers stopped people from crossing it.
That recipe is my favourite, and I cook it every Sunday.
The device was cheap, and the army began buying it in bulk.
The poem moved her so much that she memorised it at once.
The tool sat unused until the plumber started using it again.
